about: local contests of 2024 in Utah, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

medsl.name: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, Precinct-Level Returns 2024 by Individual State, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/NYTPDU, version 1.0
medsl.note: precinct returns compiled by MEDSL from each state's official sources (named per state in its README); added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py, files 2024-ut-precinct-general.csv

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

forecasts.note: transferred, not yet checked: route (a)'s class-C terms, fitted on the state legislative races of earlier years (Klarner's, and New Jersey's and Virginia's 2023 legislatures), applied with the county's US House lean; incumbency not matched (taken as 0); back-test in data/local/backtest-local-partisan.json

forecast_inputs.lean_of: the Democrats' two-party share of the US House vote in the race's counties at the previous general, minus one half (MEDSL's precinct returns)

p.under: the model's own (D3-v1.1), normal; transferred, not yet checked
p.forecast_scope: the race's counties (class C's terms with the counties' US House lean)

calibration_not_of_record.of: pooled over the fitting years' races
calibration_not_of_record.what: seen over expected near 1/2 in the fitting years' out-of-sample forecasts
calibration_not_of_record.note: the near-tie calibration of #31 (the orchestrator, 06:38), taken out by the robustness test (brief D3, amended 2026-11-07 08:36: adopted only if it improves the out-of-sample test, and still does, with no tested cell made worse, when any one scored year is left out); data/local/calibration-local.json
